title: MZ Have many different "required weapons" for a skill

posts.author: Indinera
posts.body:
but I'd like it to be an "OR".
For instance, a strike that would be available if the character has equipped a knife OR a sword OR a saber.
Or a rain of arrows if a bow OR a crossbow is equipped.
Is this doable?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
For up to two weapons, (e.g. your rain of arrows example) that already exists in the editor, at the bottom of the skill entry in your database.
For more than that, this was done via Yanfly's Skill Core - have you looked at the VisuStella Skills and States Core to see if it has the same functionality?
Edit: it does, the JS Skill Enable notetag.

posts.author: Indinera
posts.body: Which code should I use to enable it for, say, weapon types 3 and 4?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I Googled "RPG Maker MV script equipped weapon type" (I see you're using MZ, but most of the code is the same) and got this:
$gameParty.members()[x].isWtypeEquipped(n);
We don't care about the gameParty bit because the instructions for the VisuStella Skills says "The 'user' variable refers to the user with the skill."
So you would simply do
Code:
<JS Skill Enable>
enabled=user.isWtypeEquipped(x) || user.isWtypeEquipped(y) || user.isWtypeEquipped(z)...etc.
</JS Skill Enable>
